Final for Publication

Narrative and Plans
1030 W 21* Street

The Project

The subject property is improved with a one-story commercial building. OKI RE LLC (the
Applicant”) proposes to repurpose 3,600 sq ft of the current structure to commercial space to use
as an indoor event venue. The height of the building will be 18.75 feet. The proposed indoor venue
will serve as a first-class facility for members of the public to host pre-arranged events, including,
but not limited to, weddings, receptions, fundraisers, banquets, dinners, lunches, breakfasts, and
other gatherings. See floor plan and photos attached. Applicant will seek Special Use Approval
through the Zoning Board of Appeals.

The subject property is located in a block that is improved with residential buildings on its northern
half and a surface parking lot, a commercial building and the subject property on its southern half.
To allow the proposed repurposing of the building, the Applicant seeks a change in zoning
classification for the subject property from an M1 -2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District

to an B3-3, a Community Shopping District.

The following are the relevant parameters for the proposed project:

Residential Dwelling Units: None

Maximum FAR: 0.57

Automobile Parking: 30 (outdoor)

Total Lot Size: 17,558 sq ft (land)

Setbacks (existing): Front (West 21* Street): 0.73”
East Side: 0.05’
West Side: 0.67
Rear (Alley) 0.00”

See floor plans for 3,600 SF event space and photos attached.
